question_text: You had a brightly-coloured hat on. That's how I noticed you in the crowd. The correct sentence which has a similar meaning to the above situation is…

choices.A: if you had had a brightly-coloured hat on, I mightn't have noticed you in the crowd.
choices.B: if you hadn't had a brightly-coloured hat on, I mightn't have noticed you in the crowd.
choices.C: if you haven't had a brightly-coloured hat on, I mightn't have noticed you in the crowd.
choices.D: if you hadn't had a brightly-coloured hat on, I might have noticed you in the crowd.
